english.title: Operator of public transport aircraft fail to make up to date operations manual available / accessible to flight crew
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a public transport aircraft registered in the United Kingdom, failed to

(A)_[make available to each member of the operating staff an operations manual which complied with Article 116(5) of the Air Navigation Order 2016]_
(B)_[ensure that each copy of the operations manual was kept up to date]_
(C)_[ensure that on each flight every member of the crew had access to a copy of every part of the operations manual which was relevant to the crew member's duties on the flight]_
english.legislation: Contrary to articles 116(4) and 265(6) of the Air Navigation Order 2016.
